title: ID0411110-DC/Si-D/DK[170001811] - Converter_Group_DC3 & DC4 (C1)
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC3 and DC4 Converters not Found → E52 → Fast shutdown not performed correctly
Solution:
DC3 and DC4 wiring coming to FA10/FA11 were swapped → rewire correctly
Note to Warranty Manager → we didn't confirm if KF214 was actually faulty or not, so not elegible for warranty

additional_info.subject: 0411110 - ID0411110-DC/Si-D/DK[170001811] - Converter_Group_DC3 & DC4 (C1) CRM:00472000271
additional_info.body:
Hello Martin,
After the request from Francisco to check what was happening with the dispenser I have looked at remote debug station and found that while fast shutdown from DC4 was pending to go from 150V to 0V the DC3 was already in 0V.
After checking with him if this was a newly commissioned dispenser, I ask him to check with you if DC3 and DC4 shutdown lines were not swapped. It turn out that was the case. After fixing it the charger was back in operation.
This ticket will be closed.
With best regards,
